_comment: Server settings that used to be constants in the code (Documentation/Configuration.md).
How it is used: the file is compiled into the server as its defaults. To change values without
rebuilding, set SERVER_CONFIG to a copy of this file (the LAN compose file already mounts this
folder) and restart care-api and care-worker. A file that fails the checks stops the server at
start-up with the reason. Every setting is optional: one that is left out keeps its default.
uploads: the apps read max_attachments, image_max_mb and pdf_max_mb from GET /v1/config, so they
follow this file without an app update.
appointments.default_timezone must be an IANA name such as Asia/Kolkata.
